spanish: Y alma de adam, dieciséis mil, y su tributo a Jehová: treinta y dos almas.

findings.issue: Common noun אָדָם (H120, noun common, not proper) is left untranslated as adam; common nouns stay Spanish.
Singular נָפֶשׁ is pluralized to almas to agree with the numeral; the count stays thirty-two.

notes: Conjunction, sixteen thousand, their tribute to Jehová, and thirty-two match the remaining tokens.
